title: QBE Insurance (Australia) Ltd - acquisition of options to acquire Concord Agency Companies.

body_sections.Summary: QBE Insurance (Australia) Ltd - acquisition of options to acquire Concord Agency Companies.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 25 January 2005 the ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.  QBE supplies general insurance products in Australia.  Concord is a collection of underwriting agents that distribute insurance products to intermediaries (agents and brokers).  The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to raise upstream rivals'  costs because: Concord does not distribute any other insurance underwriters' products; and insurers have other distribution channels as well as the ability to vertically integrate.
